title: Optum Equipment Services Technician — mock phone screen
instructions: Put headphones on if you want, or play on speakers and keep Live listen running so the helper briefs each question.

steps.text: Hi Wyatt, thanks for taking the time today. I'm Jordan from Optum recruiting for the Equipment Services Technician role in Charlotte. This will be a short technical and experience screen. Ready to get started?
First, this role is onsite Sunday through Thursday, second shift from two p.m. to eleven thirty p.m., with occasional Saturday overtime. Are you available for that schedule?
Walk me through how you troubleshoot a machine that suddenly stops on an automated production line. What do you check first?
Tell me about a time you diagnosed a complex electrical or electronics issue under time pressure. What was the fault, and how did you isolate it?
How have you used SKED or another C-M-M-S day to day for work orders, parts, and maintenance history?
What experience do you have with PLCs or HMIs, such as Allen-Bradley, Rockwell Studio 5000, or Beckhoff?
If two machines are down and production is waiting, how do you prioritize, and how do you communicate status over the radio?
Why are you interested in Optum and mail-order pharmacy automation equipment specifically?
Great. Before we wrap, what questions do you have for me about the Charlotte team or the equipment you'd support?
